```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot
ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy, color = class)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Engine Displacement vs. Highway Gas Mileage",
    x = "Displacement (liters)",
    y = "Highway MPG",
    color = "Class"
  )
```
